Privacy

What you type stays in your browser.

● Last updated November 21, 2026

What stays in your browser

What you enter is worked out on your device and never uploaded; there is no account or server to receive it. Your latest portfolio stays in this tab, so a lesson can use it, until you close the tab.

Plus stays on your Mac

The Plus app reads your account files on your computer. Your numbers never leave it.

What the sign-up form sends

Only if you submit it: your email, role, school (if given), plan interest and consent. It goes only to Formspree, our form service, which keeps it under its own privacy policy. No portfolio data ever leaves your browser. We use it to email you about UFO; reply to any email and we’ll delete it.

The form loads no outside script: your browser posts the answers itself when you press “Get notified”.

No analytics, no cookies

No cookies, analytics, trackers, or third-party scripts, fonts or images. GitHub Pages, our host, keeps its own server logs.

Payments

Plus purchases are paid on Stripe’s page, under Stripe’s privacy policy. Card details never touch this site. Stripe shares your purchase details with us, such as your email address, so we can contact you to set up Plus.
